text.en:
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 374 February 11, 1972
CREATING A CABINET COMMITTEE TO STUDY AND RECOMMEND SOLUTIONS TO THE
CHINESE PROBLEM
By virtue of the powers vested in me by law, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do
hereby create a cabinet committee to study and recommend solutions to the local Chinese problem as it affects
national security and protection of our sovereignty, composed of the following:
Secretary of Foreign Affairs
Secretary of Education
Secretary of Finance
Chairman, National Economic Council
Governor, Central Bank of the Philippines
Chairman, Board of Investments
Secretary of National Defense
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-two.
